key_insight: ER-Pose replaces the common box-driven paradigm with a keypoint-driven representation learning strategy for single-stage, real-time multi-person pose estimation, yielding more accurate and efficient keypoint localization without relying on bounding-box heuristics.
problem_solved: Current single-stage, YOLO-like pose estimators inherit box-centric modeling from object detection, which constrains feature learning for keypoints and causes localization and scale-mismatch issues in real-time multi-person scenarios.
method: Introduce a keypoint-driven feature representation and supervision scheme that couples localization and keypoint semantics directly, rather than via intermediate bounding boxes.
Design lightweight, multi-scale pose heads and fusion modules that work with real-time detection backbones to preserve speed while improving keypoint accuracy.

Train with losses and assignment strategies tailored to keypoint-centric prediction (e.g., direct keypoint regression/classification and refined correspondence), enabling robust multi-person handling in a single-stage pipeline.
impact: Provides a practical pathway to improve accuracy of real-time pose systems without sacrificing throughput, making pose estimation more reliable for downstream applications (AR/VR, tracking, human–computer interaction) and easier to integrate into resource-constrained deployments.
visual_elements: Side-by-side schematic comparing box-driven vs keypoint-driven pipelines (showing where supervision and features are applied).
Architecture diagram highlighting backbone, multi-scale fusion, and lightweight pose heads used for real-time inference.
Speed-vs-accuracy scatter plot comparing ER-Pose to representative single-stage baselines (FPS on x-axis, keypoint mAP on y-axis).
Qualitative examples (multi-person scenes) showing tighter keypoint localization and fewer missed/duplicated poses.
paper_title: ER-Pose: Rethinking Keypoint-Driven Representation Learning for Real-Time Human Pose Estimation
paper_authors: Nanjun Li, Pinqi Cheng, Zean Liu, Minghe Tian, Xuanyin Wang
